source_documents.title: Insights Into Intramolecular Charge Transfer in a Benzoxazole‐Substituted TAPP Derivative: Solvent Effects and DFT Analysis

reference_evidence_units.quote: This bathochromic shift and decrease in intensity indicate that the molecule has high polarity in the excited state whereas the intrinsic charge transfer (ICT) and twisted ICT (TICT) states stabilize with increasing solvent polarity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAPP-benzoxazole
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solvatochromic red shift and quenching assigned to ICT/TICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a significant red shift (470 → 550 nm) and a significant decrease in quantum yield (0.41 → 0.03) were recorded in the emission spectra depending on the solvent polarity
reference_evidence_units.subject: TAPP-benzoxazole
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission red-shifts and quantum yield falls with polarity.
